threads.author: Freddy Arias
threads.summary: Asked why JOBID6664320936115551419 shows $0 CT payout. Root cause: job was moved from Gallina (3) to Gallina (1), which is not set to CT Aggregated Payout, so the parent said Refer to Children while the children said Refer to Parent.
threads.note: Adjet and Ricardo are waiting on Kailyn Jelniker to explain why the job was moved to an older contract before deciding whether to update the Aggregated CT Payout field on expired MP Client contracts.
